content: CouchDB view paging: request limit=n+1, use the extra row's key+id as startkey+startkey_docid for next page; skip only for small values; all on B-tree. Mango _find returns opaque bookmark; selector must stay identical; end detected when rows < limit. nano 11 JSON-encodes startkey/endkey/key/keys/start_key/end_key but passes startkey_docid raw.
